categories.main_business_segments: Hansung Enterprise operates primarily in two main segments: the overseas segment focused on distant-water fisheries including catch sales, import and distribution of seafood, and export of processed seafood products; and the food segment engaged in manufacturing and selling processed seafood and meat products. Additionally, there is a minor other segment involving rental income.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced food processing technologies including patented methods for manufacturing surimi-based products such as multi-layered crab sticks and fish cakes with embedded rice cakes. It employs HACCP-certified hygiene management systems and holds MSC certification for sustainable seafood sourcing. Production involves mechanized processing lines with specialized packaging technologies to enhance product shelf life and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hansung serves both domestic and international markets. Key customers include wholesalers, retailers such as department stores, discount stores, convenience stores, and specialized sales outlets in Korea, as well as export markets in Japan, the United States, and other countries. The company targets consumers seeking premium seafood and meat processed foods, including health-conscious and convenience-oriented segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities in Busan, Gimhae, and offices in Seoul and Seongnam. Its overseas operations include distant-water fishing vessels operating in the North Pacific and other international waters, and export activities primarily targeting Japan, the U.S., and other global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hansung Enterprise operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain. It owns and operates fishing vessels for raw material procurement (upstream) and processes these raw materials into finished seafood and meat products (midstream), which are then distributed to domestic and international customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous product innovation and development through its in-house food research institute, focusing on new product launches, OEM product development, and production technology improvements such as vegan frozen foods and advanced packaging. It prioritizes sustainable fisheries management, cost reduction in fishing operations, and expanding premium product lines to meet evolving consumer demands.
categories.revenue_model: Hansung generates revenue primarily through the sale of seafood catch, processed seafood products, and meat products both domestically and internationally. Revenue streams include direct product sales to wholesalers, retailers, and exports. Additional minor income is derived from facility rental operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the processed seafood market, Hansung holds a significant market share with 36.8% in crab stick products, competing mainly against companies like Sajo and Dongwon F&B. It is recognized for pioneering premium surimi products and sustainable seafood certifications, positioning itself as a leading comprehensive food company in Korea's seafood and meat processing industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Hansung reported total sales of approximately 320.6 billion KRW, with a 9.7% year-over-year increase. The food segment accounts for about 68.6% of sales, overseas fisheries 30.8%, and other segments 0.6%. Operating profit was 8.07 billion KRW, with the food segment showing strong profitability growth, while the overseas segment faced losses due to lower catch prices. The company maintains total assets of around 230.8 billion KRW and has shown steady revenue growth despite some challenges in the fisheries segment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hansung differentiates itself through a combination of sustainable sourcing certified by MSC, advanced food safety management with HACCP certification, and a diverse portfolio of premium seafood and meat products tailored to evolving consumer preferences. Its long-standing expertise in distant-water fisheries and innovative product development, including patented manufacturing methods, provide unique value in quality, safety, and sustainability to customers.
